title: The Trophy Case
highlights: Your best 10 wins are now saved and shown back as real reels — in the machine you won them on.
Tap a trophy to replay the win: the reels re-spin and the lines light up again.
A 'NEW BEST!' badge pops the moment a spin makes the case.
Your record now has two tabs — Trophies and Numbers — so neither is buried.
Quiet by default: sound is off until you turn it on (no more looping music).

title: Machines & Metrics
highlights: Four machines to play — Wild & Whimsical, Arctic, Desert, and Ocean — each with its own creatures.
A tuned, more generous default game with bigger jackpots.
Session stats: spins, win rate, net winnings, biggest win, and a winnings-over-time chart.

title: Launch
highlights: Zany Animal Slots goes live — a play-money, mobile-first slot game.
Spin the reels, match animals left-to-right across 20 paylines, and chase the jackpot.
Play-money only — just for fun, no real wagering.
